parse.title: Settings
parse.wikitext:
==Display==
[[File:Display options interface.png|thumb|right|200px|The display settings.]][[File:Display options mobile interface.png|thumb|right|200px|The display settings on mobile.]]
===Graphics===
{| class="wikitable" style="width:800px"
!Setting
!Function
|-
|Screen Brightness
|A slider that can be adjusted to make the screen darker or brighter.
|-
|Camera zoom distance
|A slider that adjusts the camera's zoom.
|-
|View distance
|([[Old School RuneScape Mobile|Mobile]] and [[Steam client]]s only) Change how far you can see the landscape. This does not affect view distance of other players or interact distance.
|-
|Hide roofs
|Choose whether roofs are selectively or always hidden.
|-
|Scroll wheel (Pinch gesture on [[Old School RuneScape Mobile|Mobile client]]s) can change zoom distance
|Choose whether the [mouse's scroll wheel/pinch gesture] can change the camera zoom.
|-
|Limit framerate
|([[Old School RuneScape Mobile|Mobile]] and [[Steam client]]s only) Can be used to limit {{WP|Frame rate|frames that are drawn per second}}. Can choose between 15, 20, 30, 60, and Unlimited.
|-
|Always on top
|([[Steam client]]s only) When enabled, the client will always be on top of other windows/applications.
|-
|Full screen
|([[Steam client]]s only) When enabled, the client will be displayed in full screen mode.
|-
|Anti-aliasing
|([[Steam client]]s only) Set the type of anti-aliasing to use. Can choose between Off, {{WP|Multisample anti-aliasing|MSAA}}x2, MSAAx4, MSAAx8, MSAAx16.
|}

|}
